<!-- pr-reviewer: 397951da0069785b1e8ab77617ada9f18d730b5c -->
Review result: no blockers. P1 floor: second review needed - this PR fixes posted G-code (#2599, P1), so AGENTS.md and the review law ask for one read-only Opus review of the diff before the merge.

What we checked. We merged the head into current main in a review worktree; the merge is clean. We built and tested that tree, debug: `camcraft-app` lib 382 pass, 0 fail (the two new `tilt_basis` unit tests run there); the seven tilt and index suites green: `tilt` 13, `tilt_a180` 8, `tilt_a180_routes` 2 plus the three route tests, `tilt_basis_compat` 2, `tilt_heights` 4, `tilt_band_dip` 4, `index_swing` 7, 8; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Law check. The basis step sits in one door: `EditOperationParams` calls `with_stepped_tilt_basis` before it writes. The page and MCP `edit_operation` both go through that door; the tests prove each route ends at basis 1 and that undo restores basis 0 with the saved angles. An edit that keeps the angles (feed, depth, origin) keeps the saved plane coordinates, so a loaded old operation that nobody edits posts exactly as before (#2157 compat law, `tilt_basis_compat` still green). `TiltedFrame::new_versioned` still refuses a basis above 1: a future file fails visibly, never silently. The edge where a kind had no tilt before and the new tilt claims basis 0 steps to basis 1; that is right, because a new index has no saved coordinates to keep. The `or_insert(1)` in `project/json.rs` is the pre-existing live-door default, not part of this change.

Done-means check: issue #2599 asks that A0, A90, A-90 and A0/B180 post the same local XY (pinned by `a0_a90_a_minus_90_and_a0_b180_post_the_same_local_xy`, which runs the whole route from CreateOperation) and that the refusal text names the A-only way (the #785 refusal already says "use Tool axis A 0 and Tool axis B 180"; unchanged here).

Not exercised: the real legacy project files from mkinney's QA runs p02-p08 (the tests build the legacy file shape from the current door; the minimal repro of the issue is covered in kind).

Verdict: ready to merge after the second (Opus) review. Label set to merge-ready.

Merge class: SAME. The head is `397951da0069785b1e8ab77617ada9f18d730b5c`, the head that the review of 08:12 UTC names (comment 7003543462). No commit came after that review. The PR merges cleanly with `main`.

This PR fixes a P1 issue (#2599), so it had a second review. A read-only Opus agent that did not write the change read the diff at this head. Its result: no blockers.

- It found one writer of a changed tilt angle on an existing operation: `EditOperationParams`. The operation page and the MCP tool `edit_operation` go through it.
- Undo restores the previous angles and the previous basis. Redo gives the state of the first apply.
- A project that is only opened and posted keeps its basis and its output.
- A refused edit does not move the basis.

Notes that do not block the merge:

- A file that a build with the defect saved after an angle edit holds the old basis with the new angles. This fix does not repair such a file. A follow-up issue records it.
- The second review did not build. It did not confirm by a run that the two route tests fail without the fix.
